build_efficientnet_model: build an EfficientNet model from config with a specified model_name like B0 through B7
create_mbconvblock: create an MBConvBlock with squeeze-and-excitation, depthwise convolution, and skip connections
run_efficientnet_forward: run a forward pass through an EfficientNet model on input image tensors
test_drop_connect: test the drop_connect function to randomly drop inputs during training with a given rate
scale_width_depth: scale the number of filters and block repeats using width and depth coefficients
